notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
Hey Puggers!

We've just updated the game, I'll list the included fixes and changes below.

Fixes included:
- fixed desert rock collision
- fixed reseting music after restarting game
- new biomes  and chunks now will spawn little bit faster and independly from the draw distance
